title.v: Danh sách người dùng đang sử dụng

query.text: [$FUNCTION]$LISTCURRENTUSERS[@#]@@userId[@#]@@listCurrentUser[@#] if @@admin <> 1 if not exists(select 1 from sysmenu a where controller = '@@controller' and exists(select 1 from sysrightmenu b where b.user_id = @@userId and a.id = b.menu_id and a_view = 1)) begin select '$NotAuthorize' as message return end exec ISWIFTStoreTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', '', '', '@@key', @strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 50, @@admin, @@userId

request.text: [$FUNCTION]$KILLINSTANCE[@#]@@userId[@#] if @@admin = 1 select @user_id as val else select 0 as val
[$FUNCTION]$CREATEALLISWIFTFILE[@#]@@userId[@#] if @@admin = 1 select @@userId as val else select 0 as val
